Generate a 20-page manga episode for a given character. Kicks the BPMN process com.etzhayyim.apps.bpmn.generateEpisode which orchestrates: LLM script (20 pages × 3-5 panels with dialogue) → ComfyUI panel render (~76 panels) → Pillow speech-balloon overlay → page composition (3-7 panel grids) → multi-record write (1 work + 20 pages) → social post (recordWithMedia + facets) → OCEL audit emit at each phase. Returns the new episode (work) AT URI plus the BPMN process instance key for status tracking.

charSlug.description: Character slug (kebab-case, e.g. rei-ayanami-evangelion). Maps to did:web:sh1n5h1x.etzhayyim.com:{slug} as protagonist DID.

charName.description: Display name shown in the post (e.g. Rei).

appearance.description: Visual descriptor tags fed to SDXL prompt (e.g. 'blue hair red eyes pale skin school uniform').

genre.description: Manga genre — controls art-style tags + dialogue register.

setting.description: Optional scene setting (e.g. 'rainy alley at night'). If omitted, randomly picked from a curated set.

checkpoint.description: ComfyUI checkpoint name (must be in pod allowlist).

episodeUri.description: AT URI of the created com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.work record.

processInstanceKey.description: Zeebe process instance key — use com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.getProcessTrace to inspect.

postUri.description: AT URI of the published app.bsky.feed.post.

volumeId.description: Volume slug (e.g. 'vol01-loneliness'). Also emitted as #tag facet in the derived post (e.g. '#sip-vol1' — derive rule applies slug → tag mapping).

coverCid.description: Blob CID of the chapter cover image (uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob). Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image.

coverAlt.description: Alt text for the cover image (required for a11y when coverCid is set).

pageCount.description: Total page count (informational; actual pages are separate com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.page records).

readerUri.description: Full-screen reader URL (e.g. https://mangaka.etzhayyim.com/at/mng4k4x1.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.chapter/{rkey}). Emitted as app.bsky.richtext.facet#link in the derived post.

status.description: Publication status. Only 'published' triggers the social derive rule.

compositedImageCid.description: Blob CID of the composited full-page image (layers flattened, uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob). Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image. Target dimensions: portrait PNG, W=1080 H≈1920 for mobile-comfortable reading.

altText.description: Alt text for the page image (a11y). Recommended to include speaker-attributed dialogue + panel-order summary.

width.description: Pixel width of compositedImageCid. Used for embed.images[].aspectRatio.width.

height.description: Pixel height of compositedImageCid. Used for embed.images[].aspectRatio.height.

layersCid.description: Blob CID of the KAMI Engine native layered document (ink / tone / color / sketch). Consumed by the full-screen reader for editable load; not used by the derived social post.

scriptCid.description: Optional: script JSON blob for replay/audit.
